verdict.rationale: Daytona ships an official MCP server explicitly documented to let AI agents (Claude, Cursor, Windsurf) interact with and control sandboxes programmatically, which is the standard mechanism by which an AI-native user issues natural-language commands that get translated into sandbox operations. This is reinforced by SDKs/CLI/API surface for full programmatic control. Missing for 10: independent hands-on evidence of a user actually driving Daytona via natural language through an agent, and no first-party NL chat interface built into Daytona itself.
